brief: Match a goal’s time horizon with the consequence of a temporary investment loss.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Money Timing"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "¿Cuándo lo necesitarás?"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Quando vai precisar?"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Match a goal’s time horizon with the consequence of a temporary investment loss.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: The same price drop can delay one goal and prevent another payment entirely.
instruction.misconception: A long horizon guarantees recovery or a short horizon makes losses harmless.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: A drop before tomorrow’s payment creates an immediate gap. A flexible distant goal allows waiting, without guaranteeing recovery.
Ana’s deadline leaves no time to wait.
Flexibility changes the response, not the investment’s guarantee.
The upcoming need determines the remaining horizon.
A fixed need limits the response to the loss.
A longer horizon does not guarantee a positive result.
The repair deadline has moved much closer.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
